doc: The vocabulary the app and the dongle must spell identically. Rules live in firmware/dongle/main/net_cfg.{c,h}, which is host-tested; this file carries names, numbers, paths and shapes.

network.doc: The dongle's own address on the USB wire, and the port it serves. Port 80 and the real-time port are reserved for the car, forwarded through untouched.

relay.doc: The ports the dongle listens on for the car's traffic, on its own address. What speaks on them is not the dongle's business.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: the device name; ajdongle for this adapter

fields.name: fw
fields.doc: firmware version, v<semver>+<build>

fields.name: build
fields.doc: the number after + in fw, as an integer

fields.name: rolled_back
fields.doc: the bootloader reverted the last update

fields.name: idf
fields.doc: the ESP-IDF version this image was built with

fields.name: state
fields.doc: whether a host is attached

wifi.doc: The station: which network it was told, and how the join is going.

fields.name: ssid
fields.doc: the network held since boot; empty when none was sent

fields.name: configured
fields.doc: a network has been sent since boot

fields.name: state
fields.doc: idle: no network; searching: not seen on the air; joining: seen, getting an address; connected; failed: the attempt budget ran out

fields.name: rssi_dbm
fields.doc: the car's signal at the dongle, null unless connected

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: Wi-Fi channel, null unless connected

fields.name: attempts
fields.doc: the join budget

fields.name: used
fields.doc: attempts spent on the current network

fields.name: max
fields.doc: the budget

relay.doc: What is being forwarded, and the last time forwarding failed.

fields.name: to_car_hz
fields.doc: control datagrams per second toward the car

fields.name: to_phone_hz
fields.doc: datagrams per second toward the phone

fields.name: udp_sessions
fields.doc: real-time sessions in use, of 4

fields.name: tcp_connections
fields.doc: HTTP connections in use, of 4

fields.name: last_error
fields.doc: the most recent forwarding failure, null when none since boot

fields.name: errno
fields.doc: the POSIX errno

fields.name: message
fields.doc: strerror of it

fields.name: count
fields.doc: how many times in a row this errno repeated

fields.name: age_s
fields.doc: seconds since it last happened

fields.name: uptime_s
fields.doc: seconds since boot

fields.name: free_heap
fields.doc: free heap in bytes

bounds.doc: WPA2's limits, not ours. A password is empty or pass_min..pass_max; net_cfg enforces that, and the character-class rule it also enforces has no expression here.
